parameters.query:
SELECT p.id, p.ip, p.ms
FROM site_proxy_stats s
JOIN proxy_lst p ON p.id = s.proxy_id
WHERE s.domain = '{{ $json.domain }}'
  AND (p.status IN (0, 1) OR (p.status = 9 AND (p.checked_at IS NULL OR p.checked_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)))
  AND p.ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ms <= 4000
  AND s.fail_count < 3
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM proxy_log l
    WHERE l.proxy_id = p.id
      AND l.result = 'proxy_error'
      AND l.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  )
  AND (s.cooldown_until IS NULL OR s.cooldown_until <= NOW())
ORDER BY s.ok_count DESC, COALESCE(s.last_used_at, '1970-01-01') ASC, p.ms ASC
LIMIT 6

SELECT p.id, p.ip, p.ms
FROM proxy_lst p
LEFT JOIN site_proxy_stats s ON s.proxy_id = p.id AND s.domain = '{{ $('Init').item.json.domain }}'
WHERE (p.status IN (0, 1) OR (p.status = 9 AND (p.checked_at IS NULL OR p.checked_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)))
  AND p.ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ms <= 4000
  AND s.proxy_id IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM proxy_log l
    WHERE l.proxy_id = p.id
      AND l.result = 'proxy_error'
      AND l.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  )
ORDER BY RAND()
LIMIT 8

parameters.query:
UPDATE proxy_lst SET
  checked_at = NOW(),
  status     = CASE WHEN {{ $json.good }} = 1 THEN 1
                    WHEN fail_conn + 1 >= 5
                         AND (last_ok_at IS NULL OR last_ok_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 10
                    ELSE 9 END,
  fail_conn  = CASE WHEN {{ $json.good }} = 1 THEN 0 ELSE fail_conn + 1 END,
  ok_count   = CASE WHEN {{ $json.good }} = 1 THEN ok_count + 1 ELSE ok_count END,
  last_ok_at = CASE WHEN {{ $json.good }} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE last_ok_at END,
  last_error = CASE WHEN {{ $json.good }} = 1 THEN NULL ELSE {{ $json.err_sql }} END,
  ms         = CASE WHEN {{ $json.good }} = 1 AND {{ $json.ms_sql }} IS NOT NULL
                    THEN {{ $json.ms_sql }} ELSE ms END,
  exit_ip    = CASE WHEN {{ $json.exit_ip_sql }} IS NULL THEN exit_ip ELSE {{ $json.exit_ip_sql }} END,
  leaked     = CASE WHEN {{ $json.exit_ip_sql }} IS NULL THEN leaked
                    WHEN {{ $json.exit_ip_sql }} = SUBSTRING_INDEX(ip, ':', 1) THEN 1
                    ELSE 0 END
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

INSERT INTO site_proxy_stats
  (domain, proxy_id, ok_count, fail_count, last_ok_at, last_used_at, cooldown_until, last_error)
SELECT '{{ $json.domain }}', {{ $json.proxy_id }}, {{ $json.ok }}, {{ $json.bad }},
       CASE WHEN {{ $json.ok }} = 1 THEN NOW() END,
       NOW(),
       CASE WHEN {{ $json.bad }} = 1 THEN NOW() + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE END,
       {{ $json.err_sql }}
WHERE {{ $json.proxy_id }} > 0
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  ok_count       = ok_count + {{ $json.ok }},
  fail_count     = CASE WHEN {{ $json.ok }} = 1 THEN 0 ELSE fail_count + {{ $json.bad }} END,
  last_ok_at     = CASE WHEN {{ $json.ok }} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE last_ok_at END,
  last_used_at   = NOW(),
  cooldown_until = CASE WHEN {{ $json.ok }} = 1 THEN NULL ELSE cooldown_until END,
  last_error     = CASE WHEN {{ $json.ok }} = 1 THEN NULL
                        ELSE COALESCE({{ $json.err_sql }}, last_error) END

INSERT INTO proxy_log
  (proxy_id, domain, url, result, http_status, waited_ms, detected_by, ms)
SELECT {{ $json.proxy_id }}, '{{ $json.domain }}', {{ $json.url_sql }}, '{{ $json.result }}',
       {{ $json.http_sql }}, {{ $json.waited_sql }}, {{ $json.detected_sql }}, {{ $json.ms_sql }}
WHERE {{ $json.proxy_id }} > 0
